# Coca-Cola and PepsiCo Annual Revenue and Net Income Investigation

**Mixed**

KO revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $47.061 billion [E4bcb2de9a9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), up from $45.754 billion for 2023-12-31 [E5fe91cb768](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). KO net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $10.631 billion [E7dbf3e383e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), down from $10.714 billion for 2023-12-31 [Ec38a6b4528](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). KO cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $2.064 billion [E43b7ebb66f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), up from $1.852 billion for 2023-12-31 [Ed73d54d5c2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of the March 1, 2023 as-of date, historical financial results through fiscal year 2022 were fully documented for both entities. Coca-Cola reported 2022 annual revenue of $43,004,000,000 and net income of $9,542,000,000 [E21a0d6d293](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/0000021344-23-000011-index.html) [Eb04f1db428](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/0000021344-23-000011-index.html). PepsiCo reported fiscal 2022 annual revenue of $86,392,000,000 and net income of $8,910,000,000 [Ee3de5a05bc](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/0000077476-23-000007-index.html) [E33b08cc733](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/0000077476-23-000007-index.html). Management guidance in Coca-Cola's 2022 Form 10-K stated an expectation for 2023 capital expenditures of approximately $1.9 billion [E2c2e4785ea](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm). PepsiCo's 2022 Form 10-K stated plans to return approximately $7.7 billion to shareholders in 2023, alongside general risk disclosures regarding developing and emerging markets [E6ef2e98572](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/pep-20221231.htm) [E42226b0733](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/pep-20221231.htm).

## What happened later

For fiscal year 2023, Coca-Cola reported annual revenue of $45,754,000,000 and net income of $10,714,000,000, followed by 2024 annual revenue of $47,061,000,000 and net income of $10,631,000,000 [E5fe91cb768](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [E4bcb2de9a9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html) [Ec38a6b4528](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [E7dbf3e383e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html). PepsiCo reported 2023 annual revenue of $91,471,000,000 and net income of $9,074,000,000, followed by 2024 annual revenue of $91,854,000,000 and net income of $9,578,000,000 [E94f73fb8be](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [E17a8de34d7](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html) [E201b4b1909](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [Ea96720018a](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html). Coca-Cola's actual capital expenditures reached $1,852,000,000 in 2023 and $2,064,000,000 in 2024 [Ed73d54d5c2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [E43b7ebb66f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html).

## The peer test

Comparing company-wide metrics through the outcome cutoff, Coca-Cola's annual revenue expanded from $43,004,000,000 for the period ending 2022-12-31 to $45,754,000,000 for 2023-12-31, and $47,061,000,000 for 2024-12-31 [E21a0d6d293](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/0000021344-23-000011-index.html) [E5fe91cb768](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [E4bcb2de9a9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html). PepsiCo utilizes a floating 52-53 week fiscal year ending on the last Saturday of December; its annual revenue grew from $86,392,000,000 for the period ending 2022-12-31 to $91,471,000,000 for 2023-12-30, and $91,854,000,000 for 2024-12-28 [Ee3de5a05bc](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/0000077476-23-000007-index.html) [E94f73fb8be](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [E17a8de34d7](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html). Net income for Coca-Cola moved from $9,542,000,000 (2022-12-31) to $10,714,000,000 (2023-12-31) and $10,631,000,000 (2024-12-31) [Eb04f1db428](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/0000021344-23-000011-index.html) [Ec38a6b4528](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [E7dbf3e383e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), while PepsiCo's net income moved from $8,910,000,000 (2022-12-31) to $9,074,000,000 (2023-12-30) and $9,578,000,000 (2024-12-28) [E33b08cc733](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/0000077476-23-000007-index.html) [E201b4b1909](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [Ea96720018a](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html). PepsiCo capex metrics are missing from retrieved XBRL tags [Ecd5a7a34b2] [E5b96e2debc].

## Cross-examination

Management projections retrieved consist of company-wide financial parameters, such as Coca-Cola's targeted 2023 capital expenditures of approximately $1.9 billion, which compared closely to the actual outlay of $1.85 billion [E2c2e4785ea](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm) [Ed73d54d5c2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). General risk disclosures regarding developing markets or currency headwinds represent qualitative forward-looking statements rather than explicit quantitative growth targets [E42226b0733](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/pep-20221231.htm) [E7ee91f1125](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134422000042/ko-20220930.htm). Specific product-line or geographic segment revenue targets were not provided alongside these entity-wide projections [Ecd5a7a34b2]. Financial outcomes confirm the realized direction of top-line and bottom-line figures but do not validate unobservable management intent.

## Limits

- PepsiCo capex metrics are missing from the retrieved financial results due to unsupported XBRL tags under Ecd5a7a34b2 and E5b96e2debc.
- No known-then vintage data available in the current context for corporate financial outcomes beyond original reported annual filings.

sections.title: What was knowable then
sections.text: As of the March 1, 2023 as-of date, historical financial results through fiscal year 2022 were fully documented for both entities. Coca-Cola reported 2022 annual revenue of $43,004,000,000 and net income of $9,542,000,000 [E21a0d6d293] [Eb04f1db428]. PepsiCo reported fiscal 2022 annual revenue of $86,392,000,000 and net income of $8,910,000,000 [Ee3de5a05bc] [E33b08cc733]. Management guidance in Coca-Cola's 2022 Form 10-K stated an expectation for 2023 capital expenditures of approximately $1.9 billion [E2c2e4785ea]. PepsiCo's 2022 Form 10-K stated plans to return approximately $7.7 billion to shareholders in 2023, alongside general risk disclosures regarding developing and emerging markets [E6ef2e98572] [E42226b0733].

sections.title: What happened later

Coca-Cola's actual capital expenditures reached $1,852,000,000 in 2023 and $2,064,000,000 in 2024 [Ed73d54d5c2] [E43b7ebb66f].
